title: Gowers inner average
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, let $F$ assign a real number $F(s,z)$ to each pair $s\in\mathbb{F}_2^k$ and $z\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Define the Gowers inner average of $F$ to be the average over all functions $y\colon\mathbb{F}_2^k\to\mathbb{F}_2^n$ and all $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ of the product $\prod_{s\in\mathbb{F}_2^k} F\bigl(s,\,g(x,y,s)\bigr)$, where $g(x,y,s)$ is the point specified by the Gowers cube construction.
caveat: The snippet uses `gowersCubePoint` but does not provide its definition, so the point in the product cannot be described more explicitly from the supplied ground truth.
